verdict.rationale: NVIDIA publishes system-level tensor throughput with precision stated (72 PFLOPS FP8 training, 144 PFLOPS FP4 inference for DGX B300). However, the evidence never says whether these figures are dense or sparse. The only dense reference is a relative claim (1.5x dense FP4 over B200), not an absolute number, so sizing remains ambiguous. Missing for 10: explicit dense vs. sparse labeling on the absolute figures, per-GPU throughput tables, a full precision matrix (FP16/BF16/TF32/INT8/FP64), and independent benchmark corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can size training and inference from published tensor throughput — TFLOPS or TOPS with precision and sparsity stated, not a bare marketing number
